column2: Welcome to Victoria 2: X, the best sci-fi space based Victoria 2 mod set in the X Universe. Thank you for playing.\n\nThis mod is still in development. If you encounter any issues, please report them to Cheese on GitHub: https://github.com/s-williams/Victoria-2-X or at the Victoria 2 Modding Discord: https://discord.gg/VFu3GjEjxM

This mod is set in the X Universe, the same setting for the X series of games by Egosoft, namely: X3: Reunion, X3: Terran Conflict, X3: Albion Prelude, X: Rebirth, X4: Foundations. The games are set approximately 900 years into the future, where humanity has entered the stars and encountered a half-dozen other alien speices, competing for political and economic dominance.\n\nUniquely, unlike other sci-fi settings, faster-than-light travel remains out of grasp for humanity and the aliens. Instead, interstellar travel is only possible due to the existence of jumpgates, controlled by an enigmatic race of ancients.

The Sandwell Archive is one of the largest depositories of knowledge in the known universe, holding critical information on Argon derived technology as well as historical records including logs and transactions. Its existence is a catalyst of learning and research.\n\nOur ally has granted us access.
Due to recent diplomatic events, we have lost our access to the Sandwell Archive.
